messages:
maya: quick one — seeing negative cache credits show up in the amortization output for some multi-model chains. not huge but surprising. example: `cache_credit: -1.4` on mid-tier tenant after rollout.
oliver: can you paste the raw row or repro? timestamp/chain id would help.
maya: yeah, here's an anonymized row:
```
chain_id: c123
models: [tiny-v1, base-v2]
request_tokens: 42
response_tokens: 128
cached_prefix_tokens: 30
raw_cost: 0.0123
cache_credit_calc: -1.4
```
@sasha any thoughts? this smells like the amortization window math interacting with model variant tokenization.
sasha: likely. we do amortize prefetch savings across requests using proportional token share, but we normalize by model-token-cost-per-token which changes when model switches mid-chain. non-linear SKU rates + rounding can push the allocated credit below zero in edgecases.
lia: also remember we apply the per-request minimum delta step (0.001) then round to 3 decimals for display — that combined with negative marginal may flip sign if the prefetch denominator is tiny.
oliver: ok plausible. do we have unit tests for variant-switch boundaries? iirc we only covered same-model chains.
maya: we don't. i logged a sample from prod traces where the same session switched from tiny-v1 to base-v2 after prompt expansion.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback probe for amortization-math-fix at 10:30 UTC if PR lands.
sasha: short-term mitigation: clamp credit at 0 when emitting to console and invoices, but keep raw value for debugging. long-term: recompute amortization using effective token-cost-weight averaged over the chain lifetime (not per-chunk), and add tests for model-switch.
lia: agree. also add a display flag in console UI to show "raw vs clamped" so that ops can audit.
oliver: can one of you file the bug and throw a small migration script to reprocess last 24h anomalous rows? we should avoid changing historical invoices w/o ops signoff.
maya: filing now — adding repro, sample rows, and suggested fix. will attach a short patch for clamp+logging as hotfix.
sasha: i'll review the patch. if safe, can ship as a canary to staging then opt-in some tenants.
lia: tagging product for invoice policy: @product-team FYI — we won't retroactively change billed numbers; display only until policy + legal signoff.
maya: thanks. will update thread with PR link and canary results.
oliver: thanks — nice catch.
